messages:
emma: did a short usability pass on the Prompt Sets -> Evals compact list. key things: legend density, approve CTA wording, keyboard focus for inline diffs.

ryan: prototype?

emma: https://figma.com/file/compact-evals/new-compact (frame: compact-diffs-v5)

nina: 1) Legend: too wide in compact mode. propose a collapsed "Legend" disclosure that expands on click/keyboard. include color + pattern (diagonal/hatch) so color isn't the only signal. aria-controls required.

ash: agree, pattern tokens exist in analytics library—let's reuse. Also ensure each legend item has descriptive text for screen readers like "High severity: red, diagonal pattern".

emma: 2) Approve toolbar: current label "Approve selected" is verbose. Recommendation: primary = "Approve"; secondary (low-weight link) = "Approve and add note" which opens modal with note pre-focused. Team setting can require notes forcing modal on primary.

ryan: backend note: we'll need approveWithNote flag for the API. i'll file ticket.

nina: 3) Keyboard flows: when a row has focus, Enter toggles inline expand and focus should move to the first action inside (three-dot menu). Single-letter shortcuts (r/m/i) may be shown in menus but only be active when the row is focused to avoid global conflicts.

ash: small tooltip on menu items showing shortcut helps discoverability. implement row-scoped handlers by checking tabindex/focus.

emma: 4) Thumbnails: low contrast on dark mode. Add 1px neutral border + 6px radius and keep fixed aspect-ratio to avoid layout jumps. Use inner stroke for dark mode.

ryan: 5) Badge copy: use responsive phrasing. xs: "Fail (3)"; md+: "3 regressions". prefer term "regressions" over "failed".

nina: empty state: replace "No diffs" with "No regressions found" and include CTA "Run full test suite" with hint "Press R to run (focus a row)". If run started via keyboard, show a 3s undo toast to cancel queued run.

emma: i'll bundle these into a short PRD and update figs. adding copy candidates for approve modal: option A title: "Approve test suite — add release note"; button: "Approve"; note placeholder: "Optional: release note (visible to team)".

ux-bot: mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/compact-evals/approve-modal-v3 :white_check_mark:

ash: engineering spike requested (2 pts) to validate focus behavior and dialog focus trap.

ryan: i'll schedule the spike and link the API ticket.

emma: thanks — i'll ping when PRD + updated frames are ready for copy/a11y review.

nina: :thumbsup:

ash: :rocket:
